semiconductor_relevance: High — Plasma-Therm specializes in advanced plasma processing equipment critical for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Plasma-Therm is a leading manufacturer of advanced plasma processing equipment, focusing on etch, deposition, and plasma dicing technologies essential for semiconductor fabrication. Their systems are utilized across various applications, including integrated circuits, MEMS, and solar power cells, providing reliable and innovative solutions to their global customer base.
capabilities: Deposition systems for thin film applications
Plasma dicing systems for chip packaging

regional_presence.North America: Plasma-Therm has sales and service locations across North America to support its customer base.
regional_presence.Europe: The company maintains a presence in Europe to cater to its global clientele.
regional_presence.Asia-Pacific: Plasma-Therm services the Asia-Pacific region, enhancing its global reach and support capabilities.
